verdict.rationale: Issuing API credentials is a fair question for LM Studio, since it serves a REST/OpenAI-like API locally and on the network. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents API keys, auth tokens, or scoped or least-privilege credentials of any kind. The network-serving toggle only opens the server beyond localhost and is not a credential or scoping control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
